view.investment_thesis: ServiceNow retains an attractive enterprise software growth profile, supported by high gross margins, substantial free cash flow and robust revenue expansion. A more compelling ownership case requires evidence that growth is producing stronger operating leverage and renewed EPS growth without a material deterioration in price momentum.
